title: Elderly Woman Holding Baby Outdoors, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait featuring an older woman holding a small infant in her arms on a sunny residential lawn. The woman wears round spectacles, a dark tilted hat or fascinator, a white collared blouse, and a sharp, tailored skirt suit with structured shoulder pads paired with dark lace-up oxfords. The baby is dressed in an ornate white ruffled dress, soft white socks, and baby shoes. In the background, a prominent bare tree trunk frames the subjects, with a sidewalk, quiet suburban street, and a vintage 1940s car parked in the distance. The print features classic deckled, scalloped edges popular in mid-1940s photo processing.
